title: Support runtime reasoning and verbosity controls
description:
Add first-class runtime support for reasoning_effort and verbosity so host applications can configure GPT-5-family controls for Tactus agents and LLM-backed models.

Definition of Done:
- Runtime accepts reasoning_effort and verbosity.
- Settings propagate through agents, LLMModelBackend, ModelPrimitive, and DSPy LM configuration.
- Chat and Responses API shapes are covered by tests.
- Targeted tests pass.
right_now_summary: Runtime support now propagates reasoning effort and verbosity settings across agents, models, APIs, and tests.
